personality_one_liner: A pristine, trustworthy Turkish school appointment portal with iOS-native typography and warm stone aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS vertical padding with 16pt lateral margins and sticky bottom CTA anchoring.

do's: Use frosted glass header and bottom sheets for sticky controls over scrolling content
Ensure translucent tinted base behind text over photos
dont's: Avoid applying blur to form fields or dense tabular rows
Do not use transparent bars without tinted backing

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Role-based sign in and registration for Teachers, Parents, and School Security.

states.empty: Please enter your school registered email and password.
states.error: Invalid email or password. Please try again.

screens.layout: Clean card container with segmented role selector (Veli, Öğretmen, Güvenlik), email/password inputs, and a primary action button.

screens.name: TeacherDashboard
screens.purpose: Weekly slot management and upcoming parent consultations for teachers.

states.empty: No appointment slots created yet. Tap '+' to open new consultation hours.
states.error: Failed to load teacher schedule. Tap retry.

screens.layout: Top summary banner with Kahramankazan Şehit Ömer Takdemir Ortaokulu branding, weekly slot creator card, and list of booked/available consultation hours with quick toggle controls.

screens.name: ParentDashboard
screens.purpose: Browse available teacher slots, book appointments, and view QR entry passes.

states.empty: No available appointments found matching your criteria.
states.error: Could not connect to appointment service. Please retry.

screens.layout: Hero greeting banner, teacher directory search, active bookings list with QR entry code modal, and instant booking bottom sheet.

screens.name: SecurityScanner
screens.purpose: Gate security check-in verification for parents arriving with active appointment QR codes.

states.empty: Ready to scan parent QR codes for today's active appointments.
states.error: Pass verification failed. Invalid or expired token.

screens.layout: Camera viewfinder simulation with manual token lookup input, real-time success/denial status banner, and audit log of verified parent entries.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all Turkish strings match the app language requirements. Implement role-based navigation so teachers manage slots, parents book appointments, and security guards verify QR codes. Observe safe areas and stick to iOS-Native Clean styling with 16pt margins and sticky CTAs.
